subject: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai
messages:
From: Ollie Marsh <ollie@novex.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Novex Procurement <procure@novex.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai

Hi Irene / Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novex leadership liked the throughput profile and the KV-cache savings. Procurement has asked us to get an "apples-to-apples" financial: specifically, they want a clean comparison between a one-time migration stipend (to cover integration and validation) versus an ongoing run-rate discount applied to usage.

Key constraints for us:
- Procurement needs an internal decision by 2026-11-30.
- Any migration stipend must be deliverable as a credit on first invoice or a separate one-time invoice.
- We care about predictable unit economics in Q1 post-migration (first 3 months).

Attached is our RFP Q&A and the procurement checklist — look under the "finance" tab. Can you sketch numbers for both approaches (migration stipend bands and equivalent first-year effective discount)? Also include any ops caveats (e.g., premium for guaranteed latencies or managed migration support).

Appreciate a quick turn — happy to hop on a call if that helps.

Best,
Ollie
Ollie Marsh
Head of Cloud Engineering, Novex AI
Attachments: Novex_RFP_Q&A.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Ollie Marsh <ollie@novex.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T12:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai

Hi Ollie — thanks for the clear brief and the deadline. Connor and I will pull together two parallel sketches:

1) One-time migration stipend (credit applied to first invoice) — will include estimated engineering hours, validation runs, and coordination effort for private VPC peering.
2) Run-rate discount plan — tiered by committed volume (monthly tokens/embed units) with an accelerated discount in Q1 to offset risk.

Ops caveats we’ll call out: live traffic migration (can be fast, but requires stereo-run for 48–72 hrs), and any SLA uplift (latency SLOs) you ask us to guarantee while on a cheaper model flavor. Those both add cost.

I attached a very rough sketch (proposed_takeover_terms.xlsx) — placeholder numbers only. Connor, tagging you for calibrating the migration-hours estimate. Karthik / Stephanie — we’ll need a quick economics sign-off before we share something formal with Novex.

Can you do a 30-minute call on Tue 2026-11-09 10:00 PT to walk through this?

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_takeover_terms.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai

Irene — forwarding Ollie's ask. Quick internal take: if Novex is on the table for a 12-month minimum commit we can be more aggressive on run-rate. Ballpark options we should evaluate: 

- Option A (conservative): $75k one-time stipend (credit) + standard tiered pricing (no additional discount).
- Option B (balanced): $100k stipend + 18% off usage in year 1, 12% thereafter.
- Option C (aggressive, for 12m COMMIT): $0 stipend; 25% off run-rate for the first 12 months (higher margin hit but locks runway).

Questions for the model:
- Margin impact for each scenario (C-level view).
- Operational risk: do we need SRE hours built into the stipend? If so, how many FTE-weeks?

Stephanie — can you slot margin numbers into Irene's spreadsheet and add a suggested approval path? I can sign off on an economics-only exception up to $100k but anything beyond needs VP approval.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Strategy

Date: 2026-11-09T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai

Irene — thanks, the sketches are useful. Procurement pushed back on the stipend level: they want a higher upfront to front-load vendor risk (integration contractors, test harnesses). Their ask is either a $125k one-time migration stipend OR a blended-first-year effective discount of ~30% tied to an initial 9–12 month usage profile. Critically, they want any stipend to appear as a credit on the first invoice.

Timeline note: Novex procurement wants a signed commercial term sheet by 2026-11-30 to hit their FY planning cycle. If you can give us a calibrated counter by EOD 2026-11-09 that references how the stipend maps to first-year cash impact, that will make our procurement committee comfortable.

Ollie

--- Forwarded: proposed_takeover_terms.xlsx ---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer alignment & migration support for Novex.ai — proposed counter

Team — based on Novex's push we have two defensible counters I recommend we present: 

Counter 1 (preferred): $100,000 one-time migration credit applied to the first invoice + 18% off usage for the first 12 months. Rationale: splits the cost; shows commitment; keeps our FY hit bounded. This fits within Karthik's $100k signoff threshold.

Counter 2 (if they insist on heavier upfront): $125,000 stipend + 12% first-year usage discount. Reserve clauses: stipend is non-refundable and applied as credit; discount tiers decrease after month 12 unless a new commit is signed.

Operational notes to include in the term sheet: 10 SRE days included for migration validation; additional SRE time billed at standard T&M; 48–72 hour stereo-run validation window. We should also specify credit redemption mechanics (applies only to service charges, not professional services line item).

Irene — if you're comfortable with Counter 1 I can package a clean term sheet and send to Ollie this afternoon. Karthik — this stays within your economics-only exception if we go with Counter 1; please confirm by EOD.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Cloud Sales Operations
